Name: Pikachu Companion Trinket
Author: Aten77
Description:
[size=2]Adds a new Pokeball trinket that summons a helpful Pikachu companion. Requires mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url] framework.

Pokeball Levels:
Level 1 - [color=#f1f1f1]Summon a Pikachu; harvest nearby forage, Shake and harvests trees and bushes.",
﻿[/color]Level 2 - Summon a Pikachu; harvest nearby crops, Shake and harvests trees and bushes.",
[/size][size=2][color=#f1f1f1] ﻿Level 3 - Summon a Pikachu; harvest nearby forage and crops, Shake and harvests trees and bushes.",

[/color]How to obtain:
﻿the Pokeball trinket drops naturally just like vanilla trinkets do, but always at level 1 use the anvil to change levels.

Credits:
[/size] [size=2]Mushymato"s Trinket Tinker Framework and Sinister Servants Mod which allowed this to be possible and served as a good example to help make this mod
﻿All Sprites came from The Spriters Resource
[/size]
